answer: Charge every identity a small upkeep fee each epoch, burned rather than paid to anyone, that only graded work earns back. Like an ember that needs fuel, an honest agent keeps its key warm by doing real tasks, while a dormant puppet drains to zero. A farm of 1,000 keys must pay 1,000 fees per epoch or produce 1,000 passing answers, so cost grows with every fake head, while a quiet lotus of a single agent pays one. Payouts leave through a narrow inlet: capped per key, so splitting never beats working well.
